scope: Bounded current Chrome desktop maintained-player admission, output and lifecycle research; production admission remains separate.

correctness.AAC: Exact ordered packet payloads, independent host decoded YUV and PCM versus canonical source; browser presented-frame/PCM reference equality; positive track-output witness; forward/backward seek, EOF, source replacement and bounded teardown.
correctness.finite_audio: Exact bytes where wrapper construction is canonical; independent host PCM and browser decodeAudioData output against original reference; adverse controls, maintained Native Player play/seek/EOF, source replacement and cleanup.
correctness.existing_owner: Source review plus actual owner output and relevant adversarial control; close no-opportunity work without a fabricated speed benchmark.

performance.purpose: Admission overhead/no-regression gate against the cheapest correct canonical representation of identical source essence. Not a claim of CPU savings versus the failed input.
performance.metric: paired complete finite operation wall milliseconds: source read/copy and optional construction, Player open, verified initial output, playback to EOF, destroy/context close; report startup, operation and cleanup separately
performance.threshold: Median candidate/reference complete-operation ratio <=1.15 and median startup ratio <=1.25; also report paired bootstrap 95% interval. A measured miss is a stopped profile, not hidden by repeated sampling.
performance.sampling: Seven paired trials per representative profile, alternating candidate/reference order; fresh page and player each trial; no concurrent browser research workloads during timing.

stops: Existing correct owner, failed contract, no maintained consumer, or measured lack of benefit is recorded at its real scope; deferred ideas do not become completed positive research.
